# Stanford Medicine Children's Health

> > Stanford Medicine Children's Health is a comprehensive pediatric and obstetric care network serving the Bay Area with 60+ locations, specialty centers, and innovative research programs.

Stanford Medicine Children's Health operates Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford and provides specialized care across cardiology, oncology, neurology, transplantation, and general pediatrics. The organization combines clinical excellence with research and innovation initiatives including virtual reality technologies for patient care.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric care
- Specialty centers
- Cardiology
- Oncology
- Transplant services
- Maternity care
- General pediatrics
- Congenital heart defects
- Clinical trials
- Bay Area locations

- Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center

## Core Services & Specialty Centers

- [Medical Services Directory](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services.html): Directory of medical services across 65+ locations at Stanford Children's Health
- [Specialty Services](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/specialty-centers.html): Comprehensive specialty care centers and clinics for children and pregnant women
- [Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/heart-center.html): Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center for pediatric cardiology and cardiac care
- [Bass Childhood Cancer Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/cancer-blood-diseases.html): Bass Childhood Cancer Center for pediatric oncology and blood disease treatment
- [Brain and Behavior Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/brain-and-behavior.html): Brain and Behavior Center for pediatric neurology and neurosurgery services
- [Pediatric Transplant Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/transplant.html): Pediatric Transplant Center for kidney, liver, heart, lung, and intestine transplants
- [Pregnancy and Newborn Services](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/pregnancy-newborn.html): Johnson Center for Pregnancy and Newborn Services for obstetric and neonatal care
- [General Pediatrics](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/pediatrics-general.html): General pediatric primary care services across Bay Area locations
- [Children's Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/orthopedic.html): Orthopedic and sports medicine center for pediatric musculoskeletal and sports injuries
- [Center for IBD and Celiac Disease](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/ibd-celiac-center.html): Center for IBD and Celiac Disease treating inflammatory bowel and digestive disorders

## Patient Access & Navigation

- [Find a Doctor](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/find-a-doctor.html): Physician directory and provider locator for Stanford Children's Health doctors
- [Locations and Directions](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/locations-directions.html): Facility locator for 60+ Stanford Children's Health locations in Bay Area
- [Second Opinion Service](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/landing/second-opinion.html): Second opinion service for pediatric cardiology and specialist medical consultation

## Research & Innovation

- [Research and Innovation Programs](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation.html): Research and innovation programs at Stanford Medicine Children's Health
- [Virtual Reality and Immersive Technologies](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation/virtual-reality.html): Virtual and augmented reality technologies for pediatric patient care and education
- [The Stanford Virtual Heart](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation/virtual-reality/stanford-virtual-heart.html): Stanford Virtual Heart immersive VR tool for congenital heart defect visualization
